title: Perfect for Working out
body: I’ve used a lot of apps before but this app is exceptionally good. It’s got a similar options to the Fitbit app as in you can add extra goals like walk 10,000 steps or like swim 1000 meters. These are goals that you can’t set on the Apple Watch and that’s not exactly what makes this app better. What makes it better is that it uses the data from the Apple Watch. So it feels nice because you can’t cheat your way through this and the data is automatically recorded. The reason why I reduced one star is because it’s got features that are quite useless. For instance the option to limit smoking. Unless the app records this automatically, this feature will remain quite useless. But apart from that, the app is just simply great!
author: Fluyid
